title: Summarizing Known Attacks on Transport Layer Security (TLS) and Datagram TLS (DTLS)
summary: This informational document summarizes several serious attacks on Transport Layer Security (TLS) and Datagram TLS (DTLS), including attacks on commonly used ciphers and modes of operation. It aims to motivate generic and protocol-specific recommendations for using TLS and DTLS safely.

eli5.summary: Over the years, people found clever ways to break the secret-keeping system websites use. This note collects those tricks in one place so everyone can learn from them.
